RFP No. 09/ e-proc/Bhimbandh-Kharagpur -cluster-3/BETDS/ 2026-27 for Development of Integrated Eco-Tourism, Wellness & Adventure Destination at Kharagpur Lake- Sindhwarni- Bhawrakol (Cluster-3), Bihar through Public-Private Partnership (PPP) on a Design, Build, Finance, Operate and Transfer (DBFOT) Basis. 
The Bihar Eco Tourism Development Society (BETDS) (the Concessioning Authority /Authority), under the Environment, Forest & Climate Change Department, Government of Bihar, is engaged in the development of eco-tourism infrastructure and sustainable tourism initiatives in the State of Bihar. As part of this endeavour, the Authority has decided to undertake the Development of Integrated Eco-Tourism, Wellness & Adventure Destination at Kharagpur Lake- Sindhwarni- Bhawrakol (Cluster-3), Bihar through Public-Private Partnership (PPP) on a Design, Build, Finance, Operate and Transfer (DBFOT) Basis (the Project) and has decided to carry out the bidding process for selection of a bidder to whom the Project may be awarded.
